organization.name: Typesense, Inc.
organization.notes: Official About names Typesense Inc. and customer-funded team. Timeline idea 2015, firstopen-source release 2018, Cloud 2020; age uses public product launch, not incorporation. Founder article explicitly explains not raising VC; no outside equity investors identified from these affirmative funding statements.

No public designation or verified amount found in reviewed pricing page.

moats.claim: Opinionated relevance defaults and search UI/client ecosystem lower adoption friction, but open engine and standard API workflows limit proprietary lock-in.

productReasons.claim: Typo-tolerant search-as-you-type and faceting support interactive catalog discovery.
Vector and semantic retrieval combine exact and meaning-based search within the same engine.
Geo search and federated/union results can serve location-aware discovery across collections.

sponsorship.notes: Reviewed project/company sources; no separate corporate sponsor verified. Verified business steward supplied as fallback.

requirements.notes: Ubuntu 20+/recent Linuxkernel; mac OS 13+ native; Windows WSL available.
Engine includes persistence; no external SQL/Redis/queue required in documented basic route.
Raw records on disk, search index in RAM; SSD recommended.
Raft requires 3 nodes to tolerate 1 failure; single node possible without HA.

requirements.component: Local embedding model OR remote embedding provider
requirements.notes: Localmodel adds 2–6 GBRAM; remote embedding APIs have separate costs. Keyword search needs neither.
CPU inference supported; GPU not mandatory.

resources.memory: Keyword index typically 2–3 times indexed-field data; localembeddings add 2–6 GB
resources.storage: At least raw dataset size; SSD recommended
resources.os: Linux; mac OS 13+; Windowsvia WSL; Dockerhosts
resources.notes: Workload-dependent estimates, not guaranteed capacity. Empty process 20 MB is not a production sizing recommendation.

selfHosting.notes: Standalone engine, container/package/mac OS/WSL routes; no mandatory external SQL/cache/queue. Configure API keys, TLS and backups. Cloud provisioning is managed service, not self-host one-click.

oneClickInstall.notes: Reviewed official deployment instructions; no verified one-click option found. Manual container instructions are not one-click.
